title: Waypoint pack
description: Shape of presets/<mode>/waypoints/<id>.json. Loaded by presets.loadWaypointPreset. Hunt waypointPreset / waypointsId select this pack when the hunt has no inline waypoints. Sample: wp_test_1.

z.description: Floor index. Omitted → hunt floor, else pack floor, else 0.

floor.description: Default floor copied onto the hunt when hunt.floor is omitted.

mapPath.description: Optional map path copied onto the hunt when hunt.mapPath is omitted.

waypoints.description: Ordered route tiles. Inline hunt waypoints always win over this pack.
